messages:
ajay: Kicking off staged rollout for model 'orion-xl-quant-v0.4' to catalog.
Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Primary goals: verify fallback ordering, pin enterprise tenants to the high-qual variant, and confirm eviction TTLs. Please review quick checklist.
sara: ack. can you paste the pin list and fallback ordering? :eyes:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled canary at 1938765600. config: canary=5%, region=us-east-1. I'll post health events as they happen.
ops_jules: Eviction TTL for cached KV currently 300s. thinking we should bump to 600s for first hour of rollout to avoid cold starts.
kevin: agree with TTL bump. also recommend regional pin for EU tenants to keep legacy-stable variant pinned until 10%+ success metrics.
ajay: good. proposed fallback ordering:
1) orion-xl-quant-v0.4 (primary)
2) orion-xl-fp16-v0.3 (fallback-fast)
3) orion-xl-legacy-v0.2 (fallback-safe)

Here is the catalog snippet I plan to push:
```
model: orion-xl
variants:
  - name: orion-xl-quant-v0.4
    priority: 10
    tags: [quantized, fast]
  - name: orion-xl-fp16-v0.3
    priority: 20
    tags: [fp16]
  - name: orion-xl-legacy-v0.2
    priority: 30
    tags: [stable]
fallback_policy:
  type: priority
  eviction_ttl: 600
```
product-zoe: Please include a short release note: "Quantized orion-xl: ~2x token throughput at <10% median latency increase" — we'll need to coordinate messaging to existing customers pinned to legacy.
morgan: For rollout metrics, track: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, prompt-truncation rate, and qualitative hallucination evals on the eval-set-qa job.
sara: who owns the rollback gate? what's the threshold numbers?
ajay: rollback gate = eng-oncall. thresholds: error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 1.5x baseline for 10m OR quality regression: AP drop > 2 points on eval set.
ops_jules: noted. I'll prepare the runbook steps for pin rollback that ops can run automatedly.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary started on rwd-prod-canary-3 at 1938765605. health: ok
kevin: I'll watch EU metrics and defer region pins until we see 5% success on canary.
ajay: everyone, if you :thumbsup: here I'll push the catalog change and trigger canary. otherwise call it out now.
sara: :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
ops_jules: :thumbsup:
morgan: :thumbsup:
ajay: pushing catalog change now. will post updates and the rollout report in this thread.
